stories.title: Despicable Me: Minion Rush is shutting down
stories.summary: ToonHive reported that "Despicable Me: Minion Rush" is shutting down after 13 years, and the post got 182K likes. X mourned a game few still played: "THIS IS THE WORST DAY OF MY LIFE (i haven't played this game in years)" got 84K likes and "MINION RUSH SCHOOL WALKOUT" got 92K.
